reason: Factionownership fixed, items excluded and possessionnotfactionownership correct.

question.question: Can ownership of faction pieces change, and are items faction pieces that belong to the faction holding them?

expected.expected_answer: Faction piece ownership cannot change; starting faction owns its listed faction pieces except items. Items are not faction pieces and are not owned by a faction.

source_passages.quotation: **Faction-piece ownership cannot change**: each player owns the faction chosen in setup and its listed faction pieces, except items; possessing an item does not make it faction-owned.

answer.ruling: Faction-piece ownership cannot change: each player owns the faction chosen in setup and its listed faction pieces, except items. Items are not faction-owned pieces; possessing an item does not make it part of the holder’s faction.
